marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind north 15 knots increasing to north 25 this morning then
diminishing to northwest 15 late overnight. Wind backing to southwest 20
Thursday afternoon. Flurries ending Thursday afternoon. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late this
morning then subsiding to 1 Thursday morning.<br/>

marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to west 15 Thursday morning
then backing to southwest 20 Thursday evening. Snow changing to flurries near noon and ending Thursday
afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>

marine.text:
